origin.description: Attach a package name for the frame, then detach it.
origin.details: Unlike with_package, local_package always attaches and always detaches, even when the package was already on the search path.
origin.example:
was <- "package:compiler" %in% search()
during <- local({
  local_package("compiler")
  "package:compiler" %in% search()
})
after <- "package:compiler" %in% search()
c(if (isTRUE(during)) "TRUE" else "FALSE", if (after == was) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Attach a package name for the frame, then detach it.
translation.details: Unlike with_package, local_package always attaches and always detaches, even when the package was already on the search path. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

was = "package:compiler" in search()
with local_package("compiler"):
    during = "package:compiler" in search()
after = "package:compiler" in search()
return ["TRUE" if during else "FALSE", "restored" if after == was else "open"]
